people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
translations.bsb: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
translations.kjv: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
